data.name: LINCH
data.detailed_description:
Cards on the table. Your life at stake.

LINCH is a first-person card horror game for a duel with a friend or a bot. Face your opponent in a cramped train compartment under the dealer’s watch. Beat incoming cards, play bonuses, and protect your health: losing rounds brings brutal punishment.

Face a friend or a bot

Play one-on-one online or choose a solo match against a bot. Online duels require each player to own a copy of LINCH and have an internet connection.

Choose your response

Keep track of your hand, health, and bonuses. Decide when to defend, when to pick up the cards, and when to turn the match around with a bonus card. Each turn has a time limit.

Horror at the card table

The dealer, cramped compartment, sounds of the train, and punishment animations turn a card match into a fight for survival. The game contains blood and graphic violence.

Available in the current version

  • First-person card duels: two-player online matches and solo play against a bot.
  • A main mode featuring damage, bonuses, and punishments.
  • An experimental Durak mode with trump cards and attack-and-defence rules.
  • In-game voice chat and customizable controls.
  • Interface support for 14 languages.

LINCH is in Early Access. Balance, the interface, and experimental mechanics may change during development.

data.short_description: LINCH is a first-person card horror game. Face a friend or a bot in a train compartment: beat incoming cards, use dangerous bonuses, and protect your health. Mistakes at the table bring brutal punishment from the dealer.
data.supported_languages: Inglês, Russo, Francês, Italiano, Alemão, Espanhol (Espanha), Chinês tradicional, Chinês simplificado, Coreano, Polaco, Português (Brasil), Turco, Ucraniano, Japonês

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processador: Intel® Core™ 2 Duo E6600 or AMD Phenom™ X3 8750 processor or better
  • Memória: 1 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: DirectX 12 compatible graphics card with Shader Model 6 support
  • DirectX: Versão 12
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 2 GB de espaço livre

reviews.review:
Played this game so many years ago with a close friend. This was a solid indie game, it was super fun. The vibe is wonderful and the Dealer is pretty hilarious with the various props and interactions he has. Always wondered why we're dressed like Leatheface.

5/5 - Wish the game was still playable today.
